settings.heading: What is
settings.text:
The Chimpions is a curated collection of 222 NFTs, forming a network of individuals united by shared values. Each Chimpion is a 1/1 digital identity and a key to the DAO. At its core, The Chimpions is a values-first organization:

  • Integrity over hype
  • Long-term thinking over short-term speculation
  • Contribution over extraction

The store is an extension of that — wearable pixels, made for the people who show up.

settings.question: What are the Chimpions?
settings.answer: A collection of 222 unique 1/1 hand-drawn pixel NFTs on Solana. It's not just a project — it's a place to build, share, and grow.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 3–5 business days. Delivery is 3–7 days domestically and 7–21 days internationally, depending on where you are.

settings.question: Do holders get a discount?
settings.answer: Yes. Chimpion holders get a discount code in the Discord — verify your wallet there and the bot will hand you one.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: Unworn items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Reach out through the contact page and we'll sort it out.

settings.question: Where can I buy a Chimpion?
settings.answer: On Tensor or Magic Eden. Each Chimpion is a 1/1 — there are no rarity rankings, rarity is in the eye of the beholder.

settings.heading: Want to be part of it?
settings.text: Join The Chimpions - grab some merch, buy an NFT, stake to our validator, or just vibe in the Treehouse.
